metadata.question: Did satellite imagery show complete cloud coverage over the Delhi metropolitan area on January 15, 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location). - AOI: Delhi metro via a 35 km buffer around central Delhi (28.6139N, 77.2090E). - Date: 2024-01-15 (inclusive) to 2024-01-16 (exclusive). - Primary dataset: Sentinel-2 L2A (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED) + s2cloudless (COPERNICUS/S2_CLOUD_PROBABILITY). - Fallback if no S2: MODIS daily Terra (MOD09GA) and Aqua (MYD09GA) for cloud state. 2. Masking strategy - For S2: do NOT cloud-mask; instead compute binary cloud map from s2cloudless probability >= 60; use image mask for valid data; mosaic per-pixel max over the day. - For MODIS: derive cloud from state_1km bits (cloud state 1 or 2, or cloud shadow). Combine Terra/Aqua with pixelwise min (AND) to require both to indicate cloud when both present. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3). - If image collection(s) empty for date/AOI: C1. - If after masking there are 0 valid pixels (count == 0): C2. - If stats are null/NaN: C3. - Else, complete coverage if cloud_fraction >= 0.99 -> A, otherwise B. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { const getInfo = (obj) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.evaluate(resolve, reject)); try { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const dateStart = '2024-01-15'; const dateEnd = '2024-01-16'; const delhi = ee.Geometry.Point([77.2090, 28.6139]).buffer(35000).bounds(); console.log('Date: 2024-01-15; AOI: Delhi (~35 km radius)'); // 2. Sentinel-2 with s2cloudless let s2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd) .filterBounds(delhi); const s2Count = await getInfo(s2.size()); console.log(`S2 Images: ${s2Count}`); let decided = false; if (s2Count > 0) { const s2c = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_CLOUD_PROBABILITY') .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd) .filterBounds(delhi); const join = ee.Join.saveFirst('cloud_prob'); const matched = ee.ImageCollection(join.apply( s2, s2c, ee.Filter.equals({leftField: 'system:index', rightField: 'system:index'}) )).filter(ee.Filter.notNull(['cloud_prob'])); const withCPCount = await getInfo(matched.size()); console.log(`S2 with CP: ${withCPCount}`); if (withCPCount > 0) { const cloudCol = matched.map(function(img) { const prob = ee.Image(img.get('cloud_prob')).select('probability'); let cloud = prob.gte(60).rename('cloud'); const validMask = ee.Image(img).select('B2').mask(); cloud = cloud.updateMask(validMask); return cloud; }); const cloudImg = ee.ImageCollection(cloudCol).max().rename('cloud'); const stats = await getInfo(cloudImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: delhi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e13, tileScale: 4 })); const mean = stats ? stats.cloud_mean : null; const count = stats ? stats.cloud_count : null; if (count === null || mean === null || isNaN(mean)) { console.log('Calculation invalid (null/NaN).'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Valid km-pixels: ${count}`); if (count === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } console.log(`Cloud fraction: ${mean.toFixed(3)}`); console.log(`Cloud %: ${(mean * 100).toFixed(1)}`); console.log(mean >= 0.99 ? 'A' : 'B'); return; } // If S2 exists but no cloud-probability match, fall through to MODIS fallback } // 3. Fallback: MODIS Terra/Aqua daily cloud state const modTerra = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD09GA').filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd).filterBounds(delhi); const modAqua = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD09GA').filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd).filterBounds(delhi); const tCount = await getInfo(modTerra.size()); const aCount = await getInfo(modAqua.size()); console.log(`MODIS Terra: ${tCount}, Aqua: ${aCount}`); if ((tCount || 0) === 0 && (aCount || 0) === 0) { console.log('No imagery available for the date/AOI.'); console.log('C1'); return; } const modCloud = function(img) { const qa = img.select('state_1km'); const cloudState = qa.bitwiseAnd(3); // bits 0-1: 0=clear,1=cloud,2=mixed,3=not set const isCloudOrMixed = cloudState.eq(1).or(cloudState.eq(2)); const cloudShadow = qa.rightShift(2).bitwiseAnd(1).eq(1); // bit 2: cloud shadow const cloud = isCloudOrMixed.or(cloudShadow).rename('cloud'); const valid = img.select('sur_refl_b01').mask(); // use reflectance mask return cloud.updateMask(valid); }; const imgList = []; if (tCount > 0) imgList.push(modCloud(modTerra.mosaic())); if (aCount > 0) imgList.push(modCloud(modAqua.mosaic())); const combinedCloud = ee.ImageCollection(imgList).min().rename('cloud'); // AND across Terra/Aqua const mStats = await getInfo(combinedCloud.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: delhi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e13, tileScale: 4 })); const mMean = mStats ? mStats.cloud_mean : null; const mCount = mStats ? mStats.cloud_count : null; if (mCount === null || mMean === null || isNaN(mMean)) { console.log('Calculation invalid (null/NaN).'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Valid km-pixels: ${mCount}`); if (mCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } console.log(`Cloud fraction: ${mMean.toFixed(3)}`); console.log(`Cloud %: ${(mMean * 100).toFixed(1)}`); console.log(mMean >= 0.99 ? 'A' : 'B'); } catch (e) { console.log(`Error: ${e}`); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
